Pin Point Recruitment is seeking a motivated and organised Recruitment Administrator to join our successful and growing team based in Wimborne, Dorset.

Pin Point Recruitment is one of the UK's fastest-growing recruitment agencies.

We pride ourselves on providing a positive, open, and supportive workplace where employees are encouraged to succeed and develop professionally. - Managing DBS applications

- Be able to work effectively under pressure and meet deadlines

title: Credit Controller
description:
CMA Recruitment Group is working with an established professional services organisation in Bournemouth, Dorset to recruit a Credit Controller. This is a varied role combining credit control and billing, with plenty of interaction across the wider business. The successful candidate will take responsibility for outstanding debt, resolve client account queries and work closely with internal stakeholders to support an efficient billing and collection process.
What will the Credit Controller role involve?

- Monitor aged debt and work with internal teams to resolve queries delaying collection

- Provide clients with copy invoices, statements and account information
- Process card payments and maintain accurate account records
- Review aged debt and WIP with internal stakeholders
- Support the wider Finance team with account reconciliations, transfers and other revenue-related queries

Suitable Candidate for the Credit Controller vacancy:
- Previous credit control, billing or accounts receivable experience
- Strong communication skills with a confident and professional telephone manner
- highly desirable to have business to consumer credit control experience
- Organised approach with the ability to prioritise workloads and meet deadlines
- Comfortable building relationships with clients and internal stakeholders

Additional benefits and information for the role of credit control:
- 37.5 hours week (9:00am - 5:30pm Monday-Friday)
- Salary will be dependent on experience
- Central Bournemouth location, with great transport links
- Parking provided
- Hybrid working, 2 days a week from home after initial training period

description:
Supply Chain Administrator

Poole 30,000- 33,000 per annum Permanent
40 hours per week Office-based

TeamJobs is recruiting a Supply Chain Administrator to join our client's busy team in Poole.

This is a great opportunity for someone with experience in supply chain, purchasing or logistics who enjoys working with data, coordinating deliveries and building strong supplier relationships. You'll help keep day-to-day operations running smoothly, ensuring stock is available to meet business demand.

The role:

- Maintain supplier relationships, monitor performance and resolve delivery issues.
- Coordinate inbound shipments, import documentation and deliveries to third-party warehouses.
- Maintain accurate product, supplier and inventory records.
- Produce reports and analyse data to identify trends and opportunities for improvement.
- Work closely with sales, warehouse, finance and logistics teams to communicate updates and resolve stock issues.

About you:
- Previous experience in supply chain, purchasing, logistics, inventory planning or distribution.
- Experience using ERP, MRP or warehouse management systems.
- Strong Excel skills, including Pivot Tables and VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP.
- Excellent attention to detail and a confident approach to analysing data.
- Strong communication, organisation and problem-solving skills.
- A proactive attitude and the ability to manage multiple priorities.

Experience with international suppliers, import processes or third-party logistics would be beneficial.

Benefits include:
- Monthly profit share bonus scheme.
- 30 days' paid holiday, including bank holidays.
- Modern, open-plan office with free onsite parking.
- Free lunch every Friday.
- Company sick pay and an employee assistance programme.
- Perks at Work and Cycle to Work schemes.

- Company social and corporate events.

description:

HSB Technical Ltd is a specialist recruiter within the Power & Propulsion, Shipbuilding, Maritime Shipping, Energy, Subsea and Fire & Security sectors.

The job description below outlines the position of Accounts Assistant.

Overview:

Our client is looking for an organised and detail-oriented Accounts Assistant to join their finance team based in Poundbury.

The successful candidate will support the day-to-day financial operations of the business, with responsibilities covering both purchase and sales ledger activities, invoice processing, supplier payments, account reconciliations and general financial administration.

This is a varied finance role, offering the opportunity to work closely with the wider finance team, project managers, suppliers and customers to ensure accurate financial records and efficient financial processes.

The ideal candidate will have previous experience in an Accounts Assistant or Finance Assistant position, with a good understanding of purchase and sales ledger processes. Experience using Sage accounting software and Microsoft Excel would be particularly beneficial.

Our client is looking for someone who has:
- Previous experience in an Accounts Assistant, Finance Assistant, Purchase Ledger, Sales Ledger or similar finance role.
- Experience processing purchase invoices and customer sales invoices.
- Experience reconciling supplier accounts and maintaining accurate financial records.
- Working knowledge of Sage Accounts or Sage 200.
- Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel.
- Excellent organisational and communication skills.
- Good attention to detail and accuracy when handling financial information.
- The ability to manage workloads, prioritise tasks and meet deadlines.
- The ability to work independently as well as effectively within a finance team.
- A proactive approach to resolving invoice queries and financial discrepancies.

Duties and Responsibilities
Purchase Ledger
- Receive, review and process supplier invoices accurately and within agreed timescales.
- Match purchase invoices against purchase orders, goods received notes (GRNs) and supporting documentation.
- Obtain the appropriate authorisation for invoices where required.
- Process approved supplier invoices using Sage accounting software.
- Resolve invoice queries with suppliers and internal stakeholders.
- Prepare supplier payment runs and reconcile supplier accounts to ensure records remain accurate and up to date.

Financial Processing
- Process and reconcile company credit card transactions.
- Maintain accurate financial records and supporting documentation.
- Assist with month-end procedures and account reconciliations.

Sales Ledger Support
- Prepare and raise customer sales invoices.
- Work alongside Project Managers to ensure purchase orders are received promptly to avoid unnecessary delays to invoicing.
- Support receipt allocation and customer account administration.
- Monitor outstanding payments and follow up on overdue accounts.
- Maintain accurate sales ledger records.

General Finance Support
- Build and maintain effective working relationships with customers, suppliers and internal stakeholders.
- Assist with a variety of finance and administrative tasks as directed by the Finance team.
- Support the continuous improvement of finance processes and controls.
- Provide ad-hoc reporting and administrative assistance when required.
- Contribute to financial controls, audit activities and process improvement initiatives.

The Opportunity
This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Accounts Assistant or Finance Assistant to join an established organisation in a varied and hands-on finance position.

The role offers a starting salary of £33,000 per annum and the opportunity to develop your experience across purchase ledger, sales ledger and wider financial operations.

Candidates with previous experience using Sage and handling both purchase and sales ledger responsibilities are particularly encouraged to apply.

title: Business Administrator
description:
K.A.G. Recruitment Consultancy is delighted to be exclusively recruiting for a Business Administrator to join our client, one of Europe's leading food producers, based in Yetminster.

This is a fantastic opportunity for an organised, proactive and enthusiastic individual to join a busy team, providing essential administrative support across Commercial and Site Management operations.

Position: Business Administrator
Location: Yetminster
Salary: Competitive - DOE
Hours: Monday to Friday 9 00am to 5 00pm (flexibility offered on start/finish times)

The Role
Reporting to the Commercial Manager, you will play a key role in ensuring the smooth running of daily business activities, supporting customer orders, maintaining accurate records, coordinating export documentation and communicating effectively across departments.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage customer enquiries and orders, ensuring excellent customer service.
- Maintain accurate commercial records, sales information and reporting.
- Support order processing, export coordination and associated documentation.
- Liaise with internal departments to ensure effective communication and timely delivery.
- Assist with production forecasts, sales reports, presentations and customer visits.
- Maintain organised records and handle confidential commercial information.
- Support Site Management with administrative tasks and wider business projects.

Skills & Experience
You will have previous experience in an administrative or office-based role, ideally within a commercial, manufacturing or fast-paced business environment.

You will be highly organised, confident using Microsoft Office and have excellent communication skills with strong attention to detail. A proactive attitude, the ability to manage multiple priorities and a willingness to get involved across different areas of the business are essential. Experience in export administration would be advantageous but is not essential.

If you're looking for a varied and rewarding administrative role within a successful food manufacturing business, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today or contact K.A.G. Recruitment Consultancy for further information.

title: Recruitment Coordinator
description:
Recruitment Coordinator (Engineering), Rubicon Recruitment, Poole

Day 1: You ve got full training, a supportive manager and a warm database of engineering candidates to start building relationships with.
Day 30: You re finding your rhythm, your CRM is second nature and you re already spotting great engineers before anyone asks.
Day 90: Candidates ask for you by name, and you ve realised your customer service skills translate perfectly into a recruitment career.

Improve your working life and start a recruitment career, no experience required.

We re hiring a Recruitment Coordinator to join Rubicon s Engineering team, finding, qualifying and championing brilliant engineering candidates for our clients. No previous recruitment or engineering experience needed, just the right attitude and a background in dealing with people. Our engineering clients are based across Dorset and Hampshire, so you must be able to drive.

Why this Recruitment Coordinator role exists: our Engineering consultants need a steady stream of well-qualified candidates to keep pipelines moving and clients happy. This role gives candidates a brilliant experience from first contact to placement, and gives our consultants the headhunting, screening and admin support that lets them focus on winning and growing client relationships. People with a strong customer service background, from call centres, lettings, retail, hospitality or similar, often make brilliant recruiters, so we ll teach you the rest.

Rubicon is 100% employee-owned (think John Lewis & Waitrose, but smaller and more personal). The effort you put in doesn t just tick a box; it contributes to shared success and long-term financial wellbeing for the people doing the work.

What s in it for you
- £28,000 to £29,000 basic salary
- Full training, no recruitment or engineering experience required
- Genuine support to build a career from the ground up
- A close-knit team where your work is visible and valued
- A clear route to grow within Rubicon s Engineering team

Benefits include
- Salaries reviewed quarterly
- Free parking at Rubicon s HQ in Poole
- Early finish Fridays, followed by Friday drinks (first round on Rubicon)
- Quarterly performance-related bonuses
- Holiday sell-back scheme
- Training and external qualifications with the REC
- 33 days holiday (including bank holidays) plus 1 extra day for your birthday
- Quarterly team socials, regular awards and prizes including Employee of the Month
- Birthday gift from the company
- Become part of Rubicon s 100% employee-owned trust (after 6 months)
- Private medical insurance (after your first year)
- Modern office environment with stand up desks

What you ll be doing day-to-day
- Spending around two hours a day on the phone qualifying candidates
- Headhunting engineering candidates across Dorset and Hampshire through job boards and LinkedIn
- Keeping in regular contact with engineering candidates looking for temporary and permanent opportunities
- Qualifying candidates who apply to live engineering vacancies
- Writing compelling adverts for our clients engineering roles
- Preparing polished candidate profiles and CVs for clients & keeping our CRM database accurate and up to date

You ll bring
- A customer service background, ideally from a call centre, lettings, retail or hospitality
- A love of talking on the phone, and you ll be happy spending two hours a day qualifying candidate s
- A professional, confident phone manner
- Good IT skills and comfort learning new systems
- Strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy
- Essential: a full UK driving licence
- Desirable: an interest in engineering (we ll train you on the technical side)

The culture fit
You ll bring a can-do attitude, a genuine desire to learn and a proactive, positive outlook. You ll be organised, confident and always willing to go the extra mile for our candidates. We ll teach you the recruitment and engineering side; you just need to bring the right energy. If that sounds like you, apply today with an up-to-date CV.

title: Fundraising co-ordinator
company: Mosaic - Supporting Bereaved Children - Agency - Permanent
description:
Mosaic is in an exciting period of growth as an organisation and this post dedicated to fundraising will play a pivotal role in helping us to support children and young people across the county when they have experienced the death of someone important to them.

As part of a team based in Dorchester, you'll work closely with the CEO and Head of Funding to plan and deliver a range of fundraising activities and support across our communities, advising us on what more we can do to make a difference. Writing applications for grants, going to a local group to talk about an event, planning our corporate strategy - each day will be different so we're looking for someone who likes the variety and is a real team-player.

We are looking for someone with a minimum of one year's experience in trust and foundation fundraising, good writing skills, with experience of developing high-quality proposals and grant applications. You'll enjoy getting to know our volunteers and counsellors, team and some of the wonderful families we work with.

We're a small team of 11 and work across functions to help each other and share ideas. You'll have good communication skills, with the ability to build relationships with a wide range of stakeholders, including donors, volunteers, and colleagues. Mosaic is a charity for bereaved children, and we will offer you professional training on safeguarding, bereavement and charity fundraising.

Mosaic offers a pension, travel expenses are fully paid and you'll have 18 days holiday (22 FTE) plus bank holidays and time off between Christmas and New Year. Employees enjoy a NEST pension with us (Employer contribution 3%).

How to apply:

We would love to hear from you if you're ready for this challenge, and want to make a difference.

Please look at our job description to see what this important role entails, then send us your CV and a covering letter which sets out why you think you'd be suitable and how your skills and experience align with the person specification. In particular, how do you think you'd be able to contribute to our strategy and mission, set out in the strategy document attached?

title: Supply Chain Coordinator
description:
A successful FMCG business is seeking a Supply Chain Coordinator to support customer order fulfilment, inventory planning and logistics operations across a global customer base. Applicants should possess previous experience within customer service, supply chain, logistics, order management or commercial administration, ideally gained within a manufacturing, distribution, wholesale or third-party logistics environment. Exposure to ERP, CRM or supply chain systems, combined with Microsoft Excel skills, would be highly advantageous.

Specific duties of the Supply Chain Coordinator include:
- Manage customer orders from receipt through to fulfilment, ensuring orders are processed accurately and within agreed service levels.
- Act as a key point of contact for customer enquiries, resolving delivery issues and providing timely updates on order status.
- Coordinate and monitor goods inbound from suppliers, working closely with Purchasing, Warehouse and Fulfilment teams to maintain supply continuity.
- Arrange transport and distribution activities to third-party logistics (3 PL) locations, ensuring shipments are planned efficiently and cost-effectively.
- Prepare and maintain shipping and export documentation, ensuring compliance with internal processes and customer requirements.
- Monitor inventory levels across multiple storage locations, reviewing stock reports and identifying replenishment requirements.
- Analyse demand, stockholding and customer activity to make recommendations that support product availability and service performance.
- Maintain accurate information within ERP, CRM and business systems, ensuring data integrity and effective reporting.

Supply Chain Coordinator applicants should meet the following criteria:
- Previous experience within a Supply Chain, Logistics, Customer Service, Order Management, Transport Coordination or Commercial Administration role.
- Understanding of order fulfilment processes, inventory management principles and supply chain operations.
- Experience using ERP, CRM, MS Excel or other business systems to manage data.
- Excellent communication and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
- A proactive, solutions-focused mindset and a commitment to delivering outstanding customer service.

This role would suit an organised and detail-orientated professional looking to develop a broad supply chain career, combining customer engagement, inventory management, logistics coordination and operational support within a dynamic and growing business.
